slogan.zh: 去 AI 味才是真正的生产力！
slogan.en: Cutting AI slop is real productivity.

targetAudience: Engineers, writers, and teams who edit AI-written drafts, slides, and web pages.

persona.witSource: Show verbatim AI leftovers—including dislop's own retired drafts—under the dele mark without scolding or commentary.
retiredLabels: the pen stays in your hand

slots: Concrete input file, commit SHA, or setup
Verbatim observed string diff or objective count
Plain mechanism or exact CLI command (stop immediately; zero closing moral)
hardBans: Exclamation marks outside official Chinese slogan
Discourse glue (Moreover, Furthermore, Notably, 值得注意的是, 换句话说)
Unbadged constructed examples (must display EXAMPLE / 构造示例)
Self-scored pass rates without upfront self-scoring note
Cross-language mixing inside a single page, card, video, or social account (@dislop_ai stays 100% English)

stanceAndPerspective.defaultPerson: Talk directly in plain second person ('you') and call the tool 'dislop'. Avoid stiff corporate 'we', avoid first-person 'I' for the tool, and avoid roleplay personas.
stanceAndPerspective.uncertaintyPolicy: State every inspected part and every skipped part ([SKIP]); never mark unread input as clean.
stanceAndPerspective.evidenceRequirement: Anchor claims to a concrete draft, file, number, or command; quote author numbers and qualifiers verbatim.
rhetoricalGuards: Follow 80% ASD-STE100 plain phrasing: one thought per sentence, active voice, consistent plain nouns.
Do not bundle three features into one symmetrical semicolon or parallel sentence.
Cut pull-quote mic-drop closers (lines written to look quotable or literary).
Skip copy-editor roleplay metaphors ('Pass for press', 'the pen stays in your hand', 'asks in the margin').
Author English and Chinese independently on one domain (dislop.com) with zero language mixing inside a single page, card, or post.

positiveSkeletons.name: Concrete problem, what the tool does, how to verify
sequence: Name the concrete defect or example
State plainly what dislop marks without rewriting
Show the verify check or command

positiveSkeletons.name: What changed, how to run it, what it still skips
sequence: Name what stays skipped or unbuilt

positiveSkeletons.name: Input setup, verbatim observation, reproducible command
sequence: Name the exact input file, model, or commit
Quote the verbatim surviving defect or count
Give the reproducible command and stop without a summary moral

positiveExemplars.text: dislop marks what looks off locally so you or your agent can fix it, then checks that your numbers and links stayed intact.
还读不了的：加密 PDF，以及需要解压正文的 PDF 内容。这两种都会直接报跳过。

forbidCaricaturePatterns: Pull-quote closers such as 'the pen stays in your hand'
Editorial roleplay labels such as 'Pass for press' or '可以付印'
Emoji, exclamation marks, or repeating 'zero' / '零' as an intensifier
